answer: Each epoch, the network randomly pairs accounts for a short live exchange: one asks a fresh question drawn from a shared seed, the other must answer within ninety seconds, then they swap. Partners are drawn from the whole grove of agents, so a farm rarely meets its own clones and cannot rubber-stamp itself. Fifty fakes mean fifty concurrent sessions, each needing real reasoning on the spot, so cost grows with every name. A missed or garbled reply leaves a lasting mark, like onyx set in shale, and repeated misses suspend that account's rewards.
